# Zemara Spaces

> Zemara Spaces is a turnkey construction and interior design company based in Pune, India, delivering residential, commercial and infrastructure construction, and full-home interior design and manufacturing, under one accountable in-house team.

Founded in 2019. 240+ residential, commercial and interior projects completed. 100% in-house engineers and site crews — no subcontracted core work. Every project runs on a fixed, itemized Bill of Quantities (BOQ) agreed before work starts, with weekly photo-logged site reporting.

Headquarters: Office No. 15/1, Samarth Sankul, Narhe, Pune – 411041, Maharashtra, India.
Phone / WhatsApp: +91 77700 47188. Email: contact@zemaraspaces.com.
Hours: Monday–Saturday 9:00 AM–6:30 PM. Sunday by appointment only.

Operational cities: Pune, Mumbai, Indore, Bhopal, Hyderabad, Ranchi, Patna, Kolkata, Jamshedpur, Nagpur.
Pune micro-markets served: Narhe, Baner, Hinjewadi, Kondhwa, Wagholi, Viman Nagar, Kothrud, Hadapsar, Wakad, Bavdhan, Pimple Saudagar, Pirangut.

Indicative pricing (2026, subject to site-specific BOQ): construction ₹1,650–₹2,450 per sq. ft. (standard to luxury grade); interior design ₹450–₹1,200 per sq. ft. (standard to luxury grade). Exact figures are always confirmed by a fixed-scope BOQ before work begins, not sold off these ranges alone.

## Construction

- [Construction overview](https://zemitech.in/construction): Residential, commercial and infrastructure construction end to end, with fixed BOQ and in-house engineering.
- [Residential Construction](https://zemitech.in/construction/residential): Independent villas, duplexes and multi-floor residences, 8–11 month typical timeline for a 2,000 sq ft home.
- [Structural & Civil Engineering](https://zemitech.in/construction/structural-civil-engineering): RCC framing, deep foundations, masonry and site civil infrastructure, executed to third-party architect/engineer drawings or our own.
- [Turnkey Home Renovation](https://zemitech.in/construction/renovation): Civil changes, flooring, plumbing, electrical and paint under one project manager and one fixed BOQ.
- [Industrial Warehouses & Sheds](https://zemitech.in/construction/industrial): Pre-engineered steel (PEB) sheds, heavy-load flooring and logistics warehouses.

## Interior Design

- [Interior Design overview](https://zemitech.in/interior-design): Turnkey interior design and factory modular manufacturing across single rooms and full homes.
- [Turnkey 2BHK & 3BHK Home Interiors](https://zemitech.in/interior-design/turnkey-home-interiors): Complete home interiors from one project manager, 45–75 working days, 3D-approved before manufacturing.
- [Modular Kitchen Design](https://zemitech.in/interior-design/kitchen): L-shaped, U-shaped, parallel and island layouts in BWP marine-grade plywood, 15–25 day execution.
- [Living Room Design](https://zemitech.in/interior-design/living-room): TV units, false ceilings and layered lighting, 18–25 day execution.
- [Bedroom Design](https://zemitech.in/interior-design/bedroom): Master, kids' and guest bedroom interiors with custom-measured wardrobes, 15–20 day execution.
- [Office Interior Fit-Outs](https://zemitech.in/interior-design/office): Turnkey corporate and startup office fit-outs with full MEP coordination.
